Few steps. Full definitions stay on [Glossary](glossary.qmd); citeable status stays on [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## Orient first

Follow the Orient menu in order:

1. [Course overview](overview.qmd) — week map and what the course covers  
2. [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) — plain-language scope  
3. [How does LAE work?](business-overview.qmd) — value, who pays whom, sectors  
4. [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd) — who regulates what  
5. This page — how the rest of the site fits  
6. [Common questions](faq.qmd) — ten short Q&As  
7. [Key figures](key-figures.qmd) — short sourced numbers  

Handy Glossary links when a term appears: [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law); [Cap. 448G](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law); [CASK](glossary.qmd#business-and-economics).

## Then Teach

- [Weeks](weeks.qmd) — each week page has slides, notes (when published), Before you go / Takeaways, and readings
